ios.desc:
PaintMusic combines the art of music with the art of painting. With just the stroke of a finger, anyone can compose beautiful music. Each color is a different musical instrument, and you can change the musical scale to get different types of moods in your songs. If you know next to nothing about music, you can still create great masterpieces. If you are already an expert musician, there are no limits to the beautiful creations you will produce.

Tap the record button to get the canvas moving. As it scrolls by, a touch of the finger will play notes on the selected instrument. Moving your finger up and down will go up and down the scale. Tap the rewind button to go back to the beginning of the song and start again, this time adding beautiful harmonies. Once you are satisfied with your song, you can tap the home or clear button to save it. The load page will let you select any of your saved songs to listen to, or keep making changes if you want. 

Enjoy painting some amazing music!
